items.title: Introducing Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber
items.summary: Google introduces Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber, a lightweight cybersecurity model to find and patch vulnerabilities.
items.summaryZh: Google DeepMind发布了Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber，这是一款构建在3.5 Flash基础上的轻量级网络安全模型。该模型专为快速发现、验证和修补软件漏洞而微调，通过代码安全代理CodeMender独家提供给政府和受信合作伙伴，以在兼顾成本效益的同时应对日益严峻的代码安全威胁。

items.title: A scorecard for the AI age
items.summary: Sarah Friar, CFO of OpenAI, introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI首席财务官Sarah Friar提出了一套针对AI时代的实用记分卡，旨在通过量化有用工作、成功任务成本、系统可靠性以及计算回报（Return on Compute）来准确衡量人工智能部署的实际经济效益。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI财务官介绍了衡量AI投资回报率的实用记分卡，涵盖有效工作、单次任务成本与计算回报。

items.title: Four frontier launches in eight days: six labs now field a model above 50 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
items.summary: Yeah. Grok 4.5, GPT-5.6, Muse Spark 1.1, and Kimi K3 all launched within eight days. Six labs now have a model scoring above 50 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, up from two in early June - and the price of near-frontier intelligence has collapsed
